name: Foxxoco: Squish the Squirrel
source:
A short interactive fetish piece about bondage and inanimate object transformation.

Play as Lexi as she desperately tries to negotiate her way out of a rather perilous situation!

[From [url=https://sigridvjeol.itch.io/foxxoco-squish-the-squirrel]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部以捆綁和變成無生命物件為題材的短篇互動戀物作品。

扮演萊克西，看看你能不能靠一張嘴，拼命為自己從險境中談出一條生路！
